channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Glen Grunwald | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Glen Grunwald from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: James Dolan on Glen Grunwald
item.description:
Ian Begley:James Dolan on firing GM Glen Grunwald:

“We went in a different direction and Glen wasn't on board with that direction.”

James Dolan on Glen Grunwald, Mar 18, 2014. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Glen Grunwald
item.description:
Chris Herring:Melo, on Grunwald's ouster:

“I was shocked. I never heard about it and nobody knew it was coming.”

Carmelo Anthony on Glen Grunwald, Sep 27, 2013. Source: Twitter @HerringWSJ.

item.title: Mike Woodson on Glen Grunwald
item.description:
Mike Woodson was asked today whether the Knicks would match the offer sheet the Raptors gave Landry Fields and it didn't sound like they would at this point.

“That’s a Glen Grunwald question in terms of where we’re going to go with that,”

Mike Woodson on Glen Grunwald, Jul 12, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Marcus Camby on Allan Houston, Glen Grunwald
item.description:
Nate Taylor:More of the source close to Camby:

“Glen Grunwald & Allan Houston played a big role. He has a tremendous amount of respect for both.”

Marcus Camby on Allan Houston, Glen Grunwald, Jul 10, 2012. Source: Twitter.
